findings.problem: Preloader remains with document.readyState complete and no pending requests until pointer movement; overlay persists18s without interaction.
findings.cause_confirmed: 34 delayed Rocket script tags; after harmless pointer movement body changes to loaded/loftloader-loaded and overlay stops intercepting.
findings.proposed_scope: Reconcile preloader with delayed JavaScript and bounded timeout, no theme redesign.

findings.problem: Five distinct first-party JavaScript asset URLs404; browser chunk-loading and syntax errors on desktop/mobile. Home visually renders.
findings.cause_confirmed: Legacy home loads copied Elementor JavaScript while referenced original wp-content plugin assets are absent; source assets/index.html and runtime files have2023timestamps.
findings.caused_by_php_update: not_proven; no application files changed by the authorized PHP transaction
findings.proposed_scope: Repair the legacy home asset dependencies from trusted sources without blindly installing Elementor/Pro.

findings.problem: One representative article requests an image filename that returns404 on desktop/mobile.
findings.cause_confirmed: Exact requested file is absent; related same-title images exist under different scaled filenames.
findings.proposed_scope: Correct only the stored image reference after exact attachment/content verification.

findings.problem: Footer image URL is malformed and points through demo/staging text; page also shows no-post/widget placeholder messages.
findings.cause_confirmed: Malformed browser currentSrc and rendered placeholder text confirmed; intended current content scope not established.
findings.proposed_scope: Repair footer asset reference; review homepage/content intent separately, no automatic editorial production.

other_limits: S4Blinds desktop hero video loaded with readyState4 and plays in controlled browser canary, but autoplay did not start in automation; not classified as a missing image or a proven server regression.
Contact-sheet suspicions about common JBF branding, intentional carousels, consent dialogs and normal text-over-image layout were not counted as defects.
Some root pages have default/control/empty content; intent was not inferred from screenshots.
No trustworthy full pre-update visual baseline exists for all targets; present findings are not automatically attributed to PHP.
This is frontend/runtime smoke evidence, not a forensic compromise audit or a guarantee of complete security.
Spazio public rendering was checked; its PHP package/security state is outside the earlier update scope.

owner_disposition.decision: Leave the four frontend findings unchanged; no repair requested or authorized.
